services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: WEST STOCKBRIDGE, MA- Today, The Foundry, and The Stonewall Inn Gives Back Initiative (SIGBI) announced that The Foundry was certified by SIGBI as a Safe Space. SIGBI, the official and only charitable giving organization of the historic Stonewall Inn, worked with The Foundry to provide the proper training, policies and standards that ensure The Foundry is creating a safe space for LGBTQ+ employees, LGBTQ+ customers and advocating for equality.
